info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Treasury Management API
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Management API enables organizations to efficiently manage their treasury activities, such as cash flow monitoring and liquidity management. This endpoint allows for the modification of existing treasury records, ensuring that financial data remains up-to-date and accurate. Typical users of this API include financial institutions, corporate accountants, and treasury managers who require real-time access to treasury operations. By integrating this API into their systems, businesses can enhance their financial operations, streamline processes, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.
